Título do cargo: Analista de Performance & Insights


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O Analista de Performance & Insights é o contador de histórias com dados da equipe de Marketing Direto, responsável por transformar resultados de campanhas e tendências de dados de primeira mão (1P) em insights acionáveis para o negócio . Esse profissional impulsiona a melhoria contínua ao medir o desempenho de CRM & Loyalty, identificar oportunidades de otimização e criar relatórios claros e prontos para tomada de decisão pelos stakeholders internos.

Com sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados de consumidores e relacionamentos entre entidades , essa pessoa conecta informações de diferentes fontes, canais e públicos para identificar os principais fatores de sucesso. É responsável por definir, monitorar e interpretar KPIs relacionados ao crescimento de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e efetividade das campanhas, garantindo que os esforços da equipe sejam mensuráveis, impactantes e alinhados às prioridades do negócio .

O cargo exige compreensão funcional de infraestrutura de dados de marketing e conceitos técnicos , permitindo colaboração eficiente com equipes de analytics, CDP e ativação — garantindo que os insights sejam confiáveis, contextualizados e incorporados às decisões estratégicas .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Dados, Mensuração & Otimização:

  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs-chave relacionados a campanhas de CRM & Loyalty, coleta de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e conversão.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de performance de jornadas, e-mails, promoções e programas de dados 1P, traduzindo resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • Identificar tendências de performance e oportunidades de melhoria nos canais (e-mail, push, mídia paga) e fazer recomendações estratégicas para otimização das táticas de ativação.
  • Construir e manter scorecards de campanhas, benchmarks e frameworks de pós-campanha que padronizem a mensuração nos mercados.
  • Garantir que os insights sejam contextualizados, relevantes e facilmente compreendidos por stakeholders não técnicos (ex.: equipes de marca, conteúdo, CRM).


Suporte Estratégico:

  • Atuar como líder analítico da equipe de Marketing Direto, contribuindo para revisões de performance trimestrais e anuais, previsões e planejamento estratégico.
  • Colaborar com líderes de CRM & Ativação de Dados para incorporar aprendizados de dados em estratégias de segmentação, design de jornadas e lógica de público.
  • Monitorar campanhas em andamento para detectar sinais precoces de performance ou problemas, propondo ajustes em tempo real quando necessário.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em hipóteses baseadas em dados , trabalhando com analytics ou equipes de dados para validar e explorar.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhores práticas de mensuração, modelagem de uplift e frameworks de experimentação .


Experiência & Competências Necessárias:


  • 5+ anos de experiência em análise de dados, relatórios de performance ou analytics de marketing , idealmente em CRM, Loyalty ou Engajamento do Consumidor.
  • Forte entendimento de estratégias de dados 1P , métricas de CRM (open rate, CTR, CVR, etc.) e acompanhamento de performance de campanhas de lifecycle.
  • Habilidade em interpretar dados de marketing e transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio .
  • Confortável trabalhando com modelos de dados relacionais e compreendendo relações entre entidades em plataformas como Salesforce CDP ou bancos de dados CRM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, etc.) para gerar visualizações e relatórios claros .
  • Capacidade comprovada de comunicar insights de forma clara e confiante a stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil proativo, com forte visão de negócios e curiosidade para questionar suposições e identificar oportunidades.
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em CPG, varejo ou indústrias orientadas a loyalty , com alto volume de campanhas diretas ao consumidor.
  • Familiaridade com Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CDP ou plataformas similares.
  • Experiência com testes A/B, frameworks de experimentação ou análise de lift incremental .
  • Compreensão de métricas do funil de marketing, tendências de engajamento e análise de cohort.
  • Experiência em segmentação de consumidores, modelagem de retenção ou análise de atribuição é um diferencial.



Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales


Role Summary


The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.


Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.


Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.


Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.
Your Impact
  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel
Additional Information
Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos e engenheiros de dados para desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade.

Administrar e versionar código por meio do GitHub e CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), aplicando automação e boas práticas de deploy.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Monitorar performance, custos e qualidade dos pipelines, aplicando tunning e melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


O que você precisa ter

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer, com atuação prática em desenvolvimento de pipelines e soluções de dados em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Azure Data Factory, Snowflake e Databricks, com experiência em integração, transformação e governança de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com estratégias de governança e segurança de dados (GDPR, criptografia, controle de acesso).
  • Vivência com monitoramento de qualidade de dados e frameworks de controle.
  • Conhecimento em otimização de custos e performance em ambientes cloud.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.
  • Capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e habilidade para propor soluções sustentáveis e eficientes.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:
What We Offer 


Work From Anywhere – 100% remote opportunity with a results-driven global team.

Proven System For Success – No more hitting and hoping. Our battle-tested Google Ads system generates high-quality leads with consistency so you can focus on precision execution and campaign optimization.

Career Development Opportunities – For high performers, there is opportunity to grow into system-building and high-level strategy roles over time.

High-Impact Role – See your work drive results with granular execution and proactive communication.

Elite Team Culture – Join a group of specialists who prioritize precision, data, and high performance.

Paid Time Off As Needed – Take well-deserved breaks whenever you need them.

Who We Are 


Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:


Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact 


As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.


Key Responsibilities 


Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 


Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.


The hiring process:  


Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Especialista em segurança
description:
A Stone está com uma oportunidade em seu time de Segurança em Desenvolvimento (AppSec) na área de Segurança da Informação para trabalhar com foco em projetos de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais! Você gosta de buscar novos desafios e adquirir novos conhecimentos para acelerar o desenvolvimento de carreira? Se sim, venha fazer parte do nosso time de Segurança da Informação, como Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior na Stone!

O time de AppSec tem como propósito garantir que os aplicativos sejam desenvolvidos, mantidos e utilizados de maneira segura e protegida contra ameaças cibernéticas. Buscamos evitar que nossos sistemas tenham vulnerabilidades que possam ser exploradas por criminosos cibernéticos, visando proteger dados sensíveis, a privacidade dos usuários e a integridade das aplicações.


Como é ser Analista de Segurança em Desenvolvimento Senior?


Dentre as atividades de trabalho esperadas, estão:


Estratégia, Colaboração e Arquitetura Segura em IA:

  • Ser o ponto focal de segurança, colaborando diretamente com times de engenharia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Participar e conduzir ativamente revisões de arquitetura para sistemas baseados em IA, desde a concepção até a fase de produção.
  • Realizar threat modeling específico para identificar e mitigar vetores de ataque exclusivos de sistemas de IA.
  • Desenvolver e manter um programa de segurança, abrangendo atividades defensivas e ofensivas, para aplicações de Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI).

Domínio de Riscos e Vulnerabilidades de Segurança em IA:

  • Possuir profundo conhecimento em riscos de segurança e privacidade específicos de IA, incluindo (mas não limitado a) o OWASP Top 10 for LLMs :
  • Prompt Injection e técnicas de jailbreak.
  • Insecure Output Handling e riscos de execução de código.
  • Data Poisoning em datasets de treino/fine-tuning.
  • Model Denial of Service e ataques de exaustão de recursos.
  • Vulnerabilidades na cadeia de suprimentos (Supply Chain) de modelos, dados e dependências.
  • Vazamento de Informações Sensíveis (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
  • Insecure Plugin Design e riscos associados a tool/function calling.
  • Excessive Agency em sistemas e agentes autônomos.
  • Ataques de Inversão de Modelo e Inferência de Membro (Model Inversion/Membership Inference Attacks).
  • Roubo de Modelo (Model Theft).

Segurança em Arquiteturas e Componentes Específicos de IA:

  • Avaliação de Pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation): Foco em segurança de Vector databases, embeddings, estratégias de chunking e manipulação/injeção de contexto.
  • Revisão de Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Análise de limites de execução de tools/functions, segurança de memória/contexto persistente do agente e transparência de raciocínio (chain-of-thought).
  • Protocolos e Integrações: Avaliar a segurança do Model Context Protocol (MCP) e integrações.
  • Fluxos de Fine-tuning: Analisar workflows de fine-tuning e riscos de injeção de backdoors.
  • Controles de Segurança: Validar a implementação de guardrails e sistemas de filtragem de conteúdo (content filtering).

Governança, Compliance e Maturidade em IA:

  • Aplicar frameworks de avaliação de maturidade em segurança de IA (ex: OWASP AI Maturity Assessment).
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações emergentes (ex: AI Act, Executive Orders) e suas implicações técnicas.
  • Implementar controles de privacidade diferencial e minimização de dados.
  • Estabelecer políticas de governança de modelos e versionamento seguro.

Capacidades Técnicas e Operacionais:

  • Ciclo de Vida de LLMs: Conhecimento aprofundado em pre-training, fine-tuning, RLHF, alignment, padrões de deployment (API-based, on-premise, edge) e implicações de segurança do prompt engineering.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar a detecção de model drift, bias drift, concept drift e métricas de segurança (ex: toxicity scores, jailbreak attempts, PII leakage). Realizar anomaly detection e auditoria de prompts e outputs.
  • Infraestrutura de IA em Cloud: Experiência com serviços gerenciados de LLM (ex: AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI), segurança de containers para workloads de ML/AI, gerenciamento de segredos (secrets management) e isolamento de rede.

Testes e Validação de Segurança:

  • Conduzir security assessments de aplicações baseadas em LLM utilizando metodologias específicas.
  • Realizar exercícios simulando ataques como prompt injection, jailbreak, cenários de exfiltração de dados e adversarial inputs.
  • Validar controles de rate limiting, prevenção de abuso e gerenciamento de custos.
  • Testar sandboxing e isolamento para execução de código.


Outras Contribuições e Habilidades:

  • Avaliar riscos e definir requisitos e padrões de segurança.
  • Realizar revisões de código e design de arquitetura.
  • Implementar testes de segurança automatizados e auxiliar na mitigação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o treinamento e a sensibilização dos times de desenvolvimento.
  • Integrar segurança de forma eficiente nos processos de desenvolvimento (shift-left).
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências de segurança em IA.
  • Utilizar a experiência e intuição de segurança para buscar ameaças nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.
  • Ter iniciativa para buscar ou solicitar dados importantes que estejam ausentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções criativas e complexas que equilibrem riscos e necessidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade plena de leitura e comunicação eficiente em inglês.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ter capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhorias, novas soluções e alertas que possam beneficiar e/ou facilitar a operação
  • Usar habilidades de influência e negociação para direcionar os times a corrigirem problemas ou a utilizar arquiteturas adequadas do ponto de vista de segurança
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia
  • Interesse e dedicação em aprender e se adaptar a cenários que utilizam novas tecnologias com as quais ainda não teve contato e que entreguem mais segurança aos produtos
  • Comunicar-se de forma concisa, franca e assertiva, sabendo traduzir problemas complexos para uma linguagem acessível ao público com o qual se comunica
  • Possuir curso Superior (concluído ou em andamento) em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Inteligência Artificial ou cursos relacionados
  • Paixão por aprender e prosperar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança
  • Conhecimento de vetores de ataque comuns
  • Conhecimento dos serviços básicos e conceitos de segurança de Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Experiência com monitoramento de segurança, análise de logs e ferramentas forenses
  • Facilidade de trabalhar dentro de times multi-disciplinares com metodologia ágil



O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Desenvolvimento de software: conhecimentos que permitam criar códigos para funcionalidades e integrações pontuais, em especial Python
  • Experiência e conhecimento em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial, em especial interfaces conversacionais usando LLM (Large Language Model)
  • Experiência com gestão de incidentes, vulnerabilidade, riscos,etc
  • Experiência com guidelines e ferramentas OWASP

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Fullstack - Vue / Nuxt - Developer
description:
POSITION: Fullstack Developer - Vue / Nuxt
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

AtlasIntel seeks talented Fullstack Engineers with a focus on frontend development . If you excel at building sleek, user-friendly interfaces and solving complex problems , you’ll thrive on our team. We value candidates with a strong algorithmic foundation , analytical prowess , and a proactive mindset .

Our ideal engineers are self-starters who can handle dynamic, fast-paced environments , manage multiple projects , and embrace learning new technologies. You’ll collaborate with designers , engineers , and stakeholders to drive the next generation of our platforms and tools.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will

  • Develop robust APIs for various applications.
  • Build cross-platform, responsive websites with intuitive interfaces.
  • Design and manage high-performance, scalable database solutions .
  • Integrate data from multiple back-end services and databases.
  • Optimize web applications for maximum speed and performance.
  • Implement data visualization and other interactive media elements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, contributing to both development and strategic discussions.
  • Participate in code reviews , testing , and quality control.
  • Stay curious and continuously learn new technologies to improve your craft.


WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for candidates with the following skills:

  • Proficiency with Node.js .
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript (ES6) , HTML5 , CSS , and preprocessors.
  • Experience developing web apps using Vue/Nuxt .
  • Great SQL skills for data management and optimization.
  • Knowledge of RESTful APIs and how to integrate with them.
  • Experience with Git and software version control best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills , attention to detail , and an ability to learn quickly.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

While not required, experience with the following technologies will give you a competitive edge:

  • Python , Java , or Scala
  • D3.js or other data visualization libraries
  • AWS Cloud services and architecture


ABOUT US

AtlasIntel is a fast-growing tech startup headquartered in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. Our cutting-edge polling and market research tools have established us as the most accurate pollster for both the 2024 and 2020 US presidential elections. Founded by two Harvard PhDs, we specialize in real-time data collection and analytics that fuel dashboards with insights spanning economics, politics, culture, and society. Join us and help shape the future of data-driven intelligence.


WHY ATLASINTEL?
  • Be part of a mission-driven company that’s revolutionizing the polling industry.
  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of engineers, designers, and data scientists.
  • Work in a dynamic environment where innovation and learning are encouraged.
  • Contribute to products that have real-world impact on business, politics, and society.

﻿

APPLY TODAY!

Join us on our journey to shape the future of polling and market research. Reach out to us at or visit our website at for more information.

É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Coordenador de Projetos (ROV)
description:
Resumo: Coordena os processos de desenvolvimento de projetos, levanta necessidades e requisitos, acompanha cronograma, desenvolve planilhas e apresentações e controla documentações.


Responsabilidades e atividades principais:


  • Receber a documentação referente a abertura de novos projetos e preparar o detalhamento do processo, emitindo comunicados de abertura e informando às áreas envolvidas;
  • Especificar o escopo do projeto, informar as equipes envolvidas tanto da empresa como do cliente, preparando planilhas para definição do cronograma e custos do projeto e submeter ao superior para aprovação;
  • Elaborar planos de execução, comunicação e acompanhamento do projeto;
  • Garantir que todas as informações e acontecimentos do projeto serão registrados e estarão em um local de fácil consulta;
  • Realizar solicitações de compra de materiais necessários para a execução do projeto;
  • Verificar e certificar que todas as fases do projeto sejam cumpridas desde sua montagem e teste até entrega do equipamento ao cliente;
  • Analisar e identificar possíveis riscos ao projeto, auxiliando na identificação de estratégias de prevenção e diminuição dos mesmos e reavaliando desde o inicio até o final;
  • Planejar, monitorar, administrar os projetos , analisando as documentações pertinentes , garantindo que as obrigações contratuais relativas às especificações, qualidade, custos e prazos sejam atendidas;
  • Consolidar e divulgar as informações do projeto (diagramas, cronogramas, descrições de atividades, planilha de custos, relatórios entre outros), visando o desenvolvimento de produtos após cada fase;
  • Acompanhar as etapas do projeto e comparar com o escopo proposto (cronograma, custos, redefinições do projeto, etc.) verificando o valor do orçamento do projeto dentro das especificações da proposta comercial.



Requisitos Mínimos:

· Formação em Engenharias, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.

· Desejável Pós-Graduação em Gerenciamento de Projetos.

· Inglês Avançado.

· Experiência com Liderança de Equipe.

· Boa Habilidade com Excel, Pacote Office, MSProject e PowerBI.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions


This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support


This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events


What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Coordenação de Eficiência Energética
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Definir política, metas, baseline e governança de eficiência energética, alinhado à ISO 50001.
  • Gerir portfólio de projetos de eficiência, incluindo bombeamento, VFDs, reengenharia hidráulica e qualidade de energia.
  • Estabelecer e monitorar KPIs energéticos e financeiros (kWh/m³, R$/m³, demanda contratada vs. medida, FP, custo evitado).
  • Implantar planos de medição e verificação (IPMVP), garantindo savings auditáveis com ajustes de baseline e sazonalidade.
  • Priorizar CAPEX/OPEX com business cases (TIR, VPL, payback) e conduzir TRs, RFPs e contratos de performance.
  • Integrar dados de medição e padronizar cadastros e repositórios energéticos.
  • Liderar equipe técnica e engajar áreas multifuncionais, reportando resultados a fóruns executivos e auditorias.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada em eficiência energética ou gestão de energia.
  • Vivência prática em liderança de equipes e gestão de pessoas.
  • Domínio técnico em sistemas de bombeamento, motores, acionamentos (VFDs), fator de potência e qualidade de energia.
  • Conhecimento em tarifação, contratos de energia e medições com analisadores.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de Medição e Verificação (IPMVP).
  • Excel avançado.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificações: CEM, CMVP, ISO 50001, PMP ou metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e/ou SQL.


Benefícios

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Bilingual Account Executive (Hunter/Closer)
description:
SaaS Sales for DatBot.ai & Flipbooker.com • Selling to the U.S. market • PJ contractor


Why this role: Short cycles, clear ICP, good conversion, and uncapped commission on cash collected with higher rates for self-sourced deals.


About us


We’re a lean U.S. SaaS company with products used by modern marketing teams. Engineering is in Brazil; sales targets the U.S. We value clear writing, fast experiments, and cash-in over vanity metrics.


Products


DatBot.ai – AI workflows for agencies/SMBs to research, brief, and ship content faster.


Flipbooker.com – Turns PDFs into branded, gated microsites with analytics and access control.


The role


Full-cycle AE (hunter). You’ll prospect, run tight discovery, do short narrative demos, and close straightforward Team+ deals. Self-serve stays on the websites; you own outbound and expansions.


ICP (who you’ll sell)


U.S. SMB/mid-market: Heads/VPs of Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, eComm Managers, RevOps in non-regulated industries. Natural cross-sell between products.


What you’ll do


Self-source 60–80% of pipeline via email/phone/LinkedIn + short Looms; re-engage warm leads fast.


Run discovery (why change / impact / timeline ≤90 days), do a 5–8 min demo, propose paid pilots, and close Team+ plans.


Build segmented lead lists and sequences; log clean notes; share weekly insights; surface cross-sell opportunities.


Drive a close plan on every late-stage opp (dates, owners, legal/security steps).


How we measure success (outcomes, not busywork)


Ramp:


Month 1 → 4–8 Qualified Meetings; 2–3 SAOs; 1 early win ideal.


Month 2 → 12–18 QMH; 6–8 SAOs; 1–3 wins.


Steady state (M3+): 12–20 QMH / 6–10 SAOs / 2–4 wins per month.


Cash-in: US$8k–$15k+/mo once ramped (grows as we dial in).


Quality gates we care about: Show ≥70% • Show→SAO 45–60% • SAO→Win 20–35%.


You’ll be great here if you have:


Excellent English (spoken/written) for U.S. prospect calls.


2+ years SaaS BDR/AE (U.S. SMB/mid-market a plus).


Real hunter chops: list building, smart personalization, tight copy, disciplined follow-up.


Tools: HubSpot, Apollo or similar, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Loom, Calendly, Google Workspace.


Compensation (uncapped, paid on cash collected)


Base (PJ): US$1.2k–1.8k/mo + 25–40% on cash collected for self-sourced Team+ (≥US$2k ARR), 10–20% on assisted, with accelerators. Biweekly payouts.

(Attribution and tiers shared after the intro call; standard clawbacks for early churn.)


Schedule: Remote in Brazil with ~3–4 hours overlap to U.S. ET/PT.

Engagement: PJ contractor.


Interview process


Intro screen: product pitch + quick funnel/OTE math.


Skills gauntlet: cold-call opener, discovery + 5–8 min narrative demo, objection/negotiation.


Deal deep-dive with optional paid micro-trial if mutually useful.


How to apply


Send your CV, your proudest prospecting/closing win (3–5 sentences with metrics), and:


A 90-second Loom pitching Flipbooker to a U.S. VP Marketing.


Two first-touch emails (one for DatBot.ai, one for Flipbooker) aimed at different ICPs.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

    • Take initiative in creative brainstorming sessions and performance reviews.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

description:
BROKER

Estamos em busca de Broker para nosso time!


A Binswanger está em busca de Broker com foco em Escritórios Corporativos para integrar nosso time de especialistas no mercado imobiliário corporativo.


O que você vai fazer?

Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de locação e venda de imóveis corporativos;

Realizar visitas, negociações e acompanhamento de transações;
